parts.description: Primary clothing state. Drives filters on partsIndex 1.

filters._filter_tree: Target path: Index . SubIndex . PartIndex — tree stops at deepest valid level provided.
filters._tree_index: targetIndex only (subIndex/partsIndex absent or null/<0) -> whole index joined
filters._tree_slot: targetIndex + targetSubIndex (partsIndex absent or null/<0) -> whole subIndex joined
filters._tree_part: all three valid (int >= 0) -> specific part value
filters._tree_skip: targetIndex absent or null/<0 -> filter ignored
filters._blacklist_comment: String or array. If any term is a substring of the target, this part resolves to empty.
filters._whitelist_comment: String or array. Target must contain at least one term, otherwise this part resolves to empty.

parts.description: Clothing colour. Suppressed when partsIndex 0 chose 'nude'.

filters._comment: Suppress this part when the primary clothing state (partsIndex 0) is 'nude'.

parts.description: An accessory tag, comma-separated from the main clothing description.
